model.reason: Request the accepted macro design as editable, unweighted construction scaffolds, with all thirteen people at level processes. This request is not a compilation receipt.
provenance: 07r2 WORLD-MODEL.md, PERSON-MODELS.md, PERSON-INSTANCES.json, and LIFECYCLE-REGISTRY.md; accepted authored counterfactual world

All numeric intervals in this request are coarse half-open year envelopes: displayed inclusive start/end years a--b map to [a,b+1). Endpoint years do not assert birth, death, or event timestamps. Day-resolved source dates govern finer chronology; these envelopes cannot supply day-level duration shares or within-year ordering.

The native concept scaffold id valid_computational_claim corresponds to the authored Concept concept.07r2.valid-computational-claim in WORLD-MODEL.md; emitted native record identities must be recorded by the compilation receipt.

profile.person_boundary: Charles Babbage as one historical person, with an explicit counterfactual history after 14 August 1843.
profile.continuity_criterion: One continuous human life from birth to death.
profile.life_description: Babbage's whole life, opened into the standard concurrent person processes; the 1851 trial is a large positive shock whose joy and recognition contribute to his later expansion judgment.

profile.person_boundary: Ada Lovelace as one historical person, with an explicit counterfactual history after 14 August 1843.
profile.continuity_criterion: One continuous human life from birth to death.
profile.life_description: Lovelace's whole life, opened into the standard concurrent person processes; she shares the trial's joy without enlarging its claim, distinguishes mechanical consequence from judgment about supplied premises and purposes, protects sole-signature authority, and later recognizes that a durable function needs succession.

profile.person_boundary: Edward Halden as one fictional person authored to remain compatible with the documentary prefix.
profile.continuity_criterion: One continuous human life from birth to death.
profile.life_description: Halden's whole life, opened into the standard concurrent person processes; inventing the bounded question makes organization creative work, and the trial's joy and recognition later weaken his own capacity discipline.

profile.person_boundary: William King-Noel as one historical person, with bounded counterfactual household participation after 14 August 1843.
profile.continuity_criterion: One continuous human life from birth to death.
profile.life_description: King-Noel's complete life spans landed and public responsibilities, marriage and family with Lovelace, bounded support for her work, and continued estate life after her death.

profile.person_boundary: Joseph Whitworth as one historical person, with one bounded counterfactual review after 14 August 1843.
profile.continuity_criterion: One continuous human life from birth to death.
profile.life_description: Whitworth's complete life runs from mechanical training through an independent precision-engineering career, including one bounded review of the apparatus rather than participation in the venture.

profile.person_boundary: Joseph Clement as one historical person whose collaboration with Babbage ended before the divergence.
profile.continuity_criterion: One continuous human life from birth to death.
profile.life_description: Clement's complete life develops from artisan training to leading precision manufacture; his ended partnership with Babbage remains a warning in the new undertaking until Clement's death.

profile.person_boundary: Griffith Davies as one historical person, with bounded counterfactual customer participation after 14 August 1843.
profile.continuity_criterion: One continuous human life from birth to death.
profile.life_description: Davies's complete life rises through mathematical and actuarial work; in the counterfactual he restrains genuine curiosity by supplying an independent question and evidence, later invokes correction, and never joins the venture.

profile.person_boundary: Henry Prevost Babbage as one historical person, with bounded counterfactual custody after his father's death.
profile.continuity_criterion: One continuous human life from birth to death.
profile.life_description: Henry's complete life follows a military career before inheriting his father's materials and the office packet, then continuing historical work on portions of the machinery.

profile.person_boundary: George Farrow as one fictional person authored to remain compatible with the documentary prefix.
profile.continuity_criterion: One continuous human life from birth to death.
profile.life_description: Farrow's complete life moves from metalworking apprenticeship to ownership of a debt-backed precision works; he protects his foreman's honest finding despite delayed payment, manufactures and maintains the apparatus, then sells the works during illness.

profile.person_boundary: Margaret Halden as one fictional person authored to remain compatible with the documentary prefix.
profile.continuity_criterion: One continuous human life from birth to death.
profile.life_description: Margaret's complete life combines family and household accounting, material participation in Halden's risk and recovery, later stationer's bookkeeping, and seven years beyond her husband's death.

profile.person_boundary: Thomas Neale as one fictional person authored to remain compatible with the documentary prefix.
profile.continuity_criterion: One continuous human life from birth to death.
profile.life_description: Neale's complete life develops through mathematical clerical work, independent checking, an attempt to train Wills without overstating his independence, shared correction after the error, and return to assurance work after closure.

profile.person_boundary: Samuel Wills as one fictional person authored to remain compatible with the documentary prefix.
profile.continuity_criterion: One continuous human life from birth to death.
profile.life_description: Wills's complete life runs from a printer's household through clerical preparation, the office transcription error, adaptation into paired checking, later railway accounts, and family life.

profile.person_boundary: Mary Somerville as one historical person whose scientific life remains independent of the counterfactual venture.
profile.continuity_criterion: One continuous human life from birth to death.

profile.continuity_criterion: The frozen 1844 configuration through manufacture, correction, trial, service, and dismantling.

profile.continuity_criterion: The same operating office, staff, accounts, customer obligations, and correction route until formal closure.

profile.description: Babbage and Lovelace's active intellectual and working partnership, including shared delight when directed operations first persist in matter and their later differing readings of what that evidence licenses.
Babbage and Halden's feasibility and venture partnership from the invention of a bounded question through shared recognition, mutually reinforcing expansion confidence, and office closure.
Lovelace and Halden's cooperation over explicit conditions, shared pleasure in the successful trial, evidence, capacity, and their later disagreement about the limits of customer demand.

profile.label: valid computational claim
profile.description: A bounded computational claim whose question, configuration, inputs, trace, independent comparison, repetition, publication boundary, and correction route are declared and retained.
differentia: validity belongs to the declared human-machine procedure, not merely to a mechanism's internal arithmetic
the public claim does not exceed what the retained prospective evidence establishes
direction_families: freeze, execute, compare, repeat, publish within evidence, correct if contradicted
observation_methods: inspect the declared test, configuration identity, input lineage, traces, independent comparison, repeated runs, published wording, and correction record

profile.description: The unbounded Engine proposal is opened into one finite apparatus by changing the decomposition from a machine part to one exact computational question that a physical object can answer.

anticipation.description: Failed attempts to price a severed machine part lead Halden to organize the proposal by answerable claim; Babbage, Lovelace, and Halden jointly make a bounded build conceivable.

focal_change.description: A configuration is frozen, funded, manufactured, corrected, and composed into a working apparatus; the first free motion after re-machining makes material recovery perceptible to several kinds of expertise.

adaptation.description: A prospective test and narrow publication establish what the apparatus has and has not shown; differing interpretations coexist with shared joy before commercial attention begins to reinforce them.

profile.description: Individually conforming assemblies fail in composition and are corrected without changing the accepted artifact's identity.

anticipation.description: The works manufactures and inspects separate assemblies under the frozen register.

focal_change.description: Two assemblies meet their drawings yet bind under the shared drive in July 1846.

adaptation.description: The interface is re-machined, the broader improvement is deferred, and manufacture converges on a functioning composition.

profile.description: A bounded success produces shared joy and recognition, then demand that the founders convert into obligations beyond known independent-checking capacity.

anticipation.description: The successful trial first changes beliefs about feasibility and standing; four inquiries reinforce that update and create an anticipated recurring service, while the capacity ledger fixes a lower boundary.

focal_change.description: Babbage urges expansion and Halden authorizes four final deliveries in April-June 1854 despite capacity for two independently checked jobs in that quarter. Customers close accounts at the end of 1853 and reconcile them through March 1854; final signed returns are released no earlier than 1 April. Early methods, specimens, and provisional checks cannot advance final comparisons into the preceding quarter. Each man mistakes confidence moved by the same success and response for independent confirmation.

adaptation.description: Work is compressed around promises; Lovelace first qualifies the claim, then recognizes the one-carrier weakness in her own claim authority and in Neale's checking and asks for funded checking succession. A later common-source flaw in Babbage's self-comparison design distinguishes mechanical consequence from independent judgment, but the succession answer is still deferred. Guardian's final signed return replaces its provisional source on 1 April 1854; all four final signed returns are released in April, with other dates unresolved. Earlier checks cannot certify these final sources, leaving 160 final checker-hours demanded against 80 promised in the April-June delivery quarter.

profile.description: The returned table first narrows Babbage's interpretation to correct mechanism and eventually changes what he regards as the complete work.

anticipation.description: The signed capacity warning and omitted duplicate check make institutional failure foreseeable before the table returns.

focal_change.description: The table is returned; the input error and authorization trail are disclosed; the office corrects, refunds, and closes.

adaptation.description: Babbage slowly retains the human-system evidence beside the mechanical proof and finally transfers both in complete custody.
